How does this wearable option work?

The wearable option works by linking the user's account to their wearable device. When they tap their wearable on a fare reader, it deducts the appropriate fare from their account. This is similar to how contactless payment cards work, but with the convenience of wearing the device.

What are the benefits of using this wearable option?

The benefits of using the wearable option include convenience, as users don't have to carry a physical card or phone. It also offers security, as the payment information is stored securely on the wearable device. Additionally, it can help reduce wait times at fare gates and improve the overall transit experience.

Are there any limitations or potential issues with this wearable option?

The paleo diet is based on the idea that our bodies are better adapted to eating foods that were available to our hunter-gatherer ancestors, rather than modern processed foods.
